decisions.reason: As a low-cost add-on tightly linked to the firm's core web-mapping platform, and having survived the earlier pruning of weaker options, it is still worth keeping open despite only moderate standalone strategic importance.
As the firm's flagship GIS platform and a central element of its stated strategic direction, it would be very unlikely for management to withdraw it absent clear failure.

Mobile field data capture remains close to the firm's integrated geospatial solutions business, so with some market validation likely achieved but ongoing maintenance needs, the rational choice is to keep it with a moderate exit risk.

The search extension is inexpensive to maintain and complements the core web-map stack, but because search functionality can be consolidated into other offerings its withdrawal risk is the highest among the surviving products.
